content:
sam: Heads-up — HearthBank submitted a variant request. They want an INSTRUCT-style variant from a base LLM, 200k context, and an INT4 quantized build for cost targets. Enterprise customer, wants SLA.

maria: Can you paste the intake details they sent?

sam: Pasted below (redacted):
> model: open-horizon-xxl-base
> target_mode: instruct
> context: 200000 tokens
> quant: int4 preferred, fallback to int8 if quality regresses
> qps target: 30 steady, burst 120
> data: bank-logs-redacted + policy-guides

alex: Thanks. A couple notes from runtime side:
- 200k context will require KV cache split + segmented checkpointing.
- INT4 path needs kernel selection/memory planning; may block on cuBLAS vs Triton on some infra.
- We should estimate GPU memory: likely need 80GB class or sharded setup.

jyoti: For QA, we need expected eval sets. Do they have in-domain evals?

sam: They provided a 1.2k-case eval set (fincalc-type, policy Q&A, multi-hop reasoning). Also want hallucination checks and ctrl-safety tests.

maria: Proposed prioritization checklist (quick):
1) Confirm legal/data access & redaction OK.
2) Pull model weights + license.
3) Baseline eval on base (no quant) with provided eval set.
4) Run quant sweep: q8_0 -> q4_0 (per-channel) -> q4_1 (per-tensor)
5) If int4 candidate within regression thresholds, do longctx correctness sweep.
6) Performance bench (latency, tokens/sec, memory).
7) Canary deploy on dedicated pool.

alex: Add infra tasks: set up dedicated pool with 2x80GB GPUs sharded; KV caching enabled; set autoscale to match qps target.

sam: Quick command prototype for quant sweep (dev-only):
```
redwood run --model open-horizon-xxl-base \\
  --transform instructify --quantize q8_0 --ctx 200000 \\
  --eval hearthbank_eval.json --out /tmp/hb/q8_0
```
We'll iterate flags q4_0 / q4_1 / int4 later.

jyoti: Metrics to track: exact_match (where applicable), rougeL, perplexity delta vs baseline, F1 for entity extraction, hallucination rate (manual sample), and any tokenization drift. Regression thresholds: EM drop <= 3%, PPL delta <= 0.5 on average, hallucination rate <= baseline + 1.5%.

sam: Prioritization ask from customer: want POC in 10 business days. Sales is pushing for dedicated SLA. Thoughts?

maria: POC timeline tight but doable if we parallelize: baseline eval + q8 sweep (2 days), int4 exploratory (3 days), infra setup + canary (3 days). Need signoff from sales/security in day 1.

alex: I'll spin up infra ticket and schedule a reserved pool. Need sales contact to approve commit.

eng-bot: Ticket created: HB-314 - HearthBank variant intake and infra provisioning (assignee: alex).

deploy-bot: Canary env ready at redwood://canary/hb-314 (placeholder).

sam: Action items: @alex infra + pool, @maria run baseline & q8 today, @jyoti prep eval harness & sampling plan, I'll sync with sales/security.

maria: I'll kick off baseline now, posting logs to /artifacts/hb-314/baseline.log.

jyoti: I'll draft the regression checklist and a manual hallucination sampling plan.

sam: Thanks — will update the customer and ask for any missing eval data. :thumbsup:
